read_kwargs.note: Default pd.read_csv() already parses the embedded newlines correctly (quoting is well-formed). No engine='python', sep or quoting overrides needed. The only things naive reads get wrong are: keeping 351 blank rows, keeping 10 empty Unnamed columns, and the literal newline inside the first column name.

row_count_explanation: `wc -l` reports 1350 because it counts LF bytes. The file uses CRLF as the record separator (1000 CRLF pairs = 1 header + 999 data records) and additionally contains 350 bare LF characters inside quoted fields (1 in the header cell 'S.\n  No.', 349 in data cells). Accounting: header 1 record = 2 physical lines; 648 populated data records = 997 physical lines; 351 trailing all-blank records = 351 physical lines. Total 2 + 997 + 351 = 1350, which equals wc -l = 1350. Of the 999 CSV records, 351 are entirely empty ',,,,...' rows at the end of the file (records 649..999, contiguous), an Excel export artifact. True data row count is 648.

encoding_notes.bom: UTF-8 BOM (EF BB BF) present at byte 0; must read with encoding='utf-8-sig' or the first column name becomes '\ufeffS.\n  No.'.
encoding_notes.line_terminator: CRLF for records, bare LF for in-field soft wraps.
encoding_notes.header_anomaly: Column 0 is literally 'S.\n  No.' -- a newline and two spaces inside the header cell.
encoding_notes.nbsp_or_zero_width: none found (0 cells contain NBSP, zero-width space, or tab)

whitespace_artifact.pattern: LF followed by exactly two spaces ('\n  ')
whitespace_artifact.rule_is_lossless: Every run of 2+ spaces in the file is immediately preceded by a newline (verified: 0 counterexamples), so collapsing all whitespace runs to a single space cannot merge two genuinely-separate tokens. Applying the rule reduces distinct Hospital Name values from 527 to 526 (one pair differed only by the artifact); casefolding after it changes nothing further.

duplicates.method: exact = pandas .duplicated() over all 19 real columns after whitespace normalization; near_dupe_name_geo = duplicated on (casefolded whitespace-normalized Hospital Name, lat rounded 2dp, lon rounded 2dp)

geo_quality.note: Geo is the strongest field in this dataset: 648/648 present, numeric, and inside the India bbox, none zero, none swapped. The only defect is 7 rows on 3 shared coordinate pairs, at least one of which (11.12712, 78.65689) is the widely-published centroid of Tamil Nadu, indicating a geocoder falling back to state/city centroid. All 351 blank records have no geo, so geo coverage is 648/999 = 64.86% if the blank rows are counted.

candidate_primary_key.caveat: Positional row number, not a stable external ID. It will not survive a re-export of the source sheet. Recommend minting a surrogate key 'NHP:' || `S. No.` for provenance only.
candidate_primary_key.note: Given Address and Standardized Address are also unique+complete but both are derived concatenations of name/city/state/pincode, so their uniqueness is an accident of the name+city combination, not an identifier.

coded_vocabularies.note: No opaque codes (no M1_emp/S3_upg/FAC_CATEGO-style columns). `Type` is a 5-value plain-language ownership enum and needs no external codebook, only a mapping to canonical ownership values. No LGD state/district codes are present anywhere in the file.

er_readiness.note: Every row has name + lat/lon + state + pincode and 647/648 have a city, so 0% of rows are strictly unmatchable and (name, geo) or (name, state, pincode) blocking is viable. There is NO district column -- City is a town name, not an LGD district, so a (name, district) blocking key requires an external city->district lookup. The real ER risk is not missing data but name ambiguity: 114 rows (17.59%) carry a name like 'Government Medical College' that is only disambiguated by geo/city.

facility_type_finding.claim: This dataset is medical colleges, not general hospitals.
facility_type_finding.conclusion: facility_type_raw is not a column; it must be injected as the constant 'MEDICAL_COLLEGE' for all 648 rows. The 28 names that match no institution keyword are abbreviated/truncated forms ('GMC', 'Fathima Instt. of Medical Sciences', 'Dr. Vasantrao Pawar Med. Col. Hosp. & Research Centr'), not a different facility class -- every one still carries an Admission Intake, which only a teaching institution has.
